abilities.name: Mace Strike
abilities.description: Strikes an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Interpose
abilities.description: Dashes to an ally within 7 m and guards it for 4 s: 40% of its damage is redirected to the Oathguard, which gains 15% Fortified.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: Bashes an adjacent enemy for 140% Power physical damage, stunning it for 0.8 s and interrupting its cast.

abilities.name: Sworn Shield
abilities.description: Allies within 3 m take 8% less damage.

abilities.name: Gong Hammer
abilities.description: Strikes an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Clangor
abilities.description: Rings the gong: taunts every enemy within 3.5 m for 1.6 s and gains 20% Fortified for 3 s.

abilities.name: Brace
abilities.description: Gains a shield worth 18% of its max HP for 4 s.

abilities.name: Hollow Ring
abilities.description: While 2 or more enemies are targeting it, gains 25 armor and 25 ward.

abilities.name: Hacking Axe
abilities.description: Strikes an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: Heals 25% of its missing HP, then regenerates 2% of max HP per second for 4 s.

abilities.name: Gut Cleave
abilities.description: Cleaves a 90° cone within 2 m for 120% Power physical damage, healing for 30% of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Thick Blood
abilities.description: Regenerates 0.8% of max HP per second, doubled while below 40% HP.

abilities.name: Spiked Gauntlet
abilities.description: Strikes an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Bristle
abilities.description: For 4 s, reflects 40% of melee weapon damage taken and gains 20 armor.

abilities.name: Caltrop Scatter
abilities.description: Scatters caltrops in a 2.5 m circle around itself for 4 s: enemies inside are slowed 30% and take 15% Power physical damage every 0.5 s.

abilities.name: Barbed Hide
abilities.description: Reflects 15% of melee weapon damage taken and has 10 extra armor.

abilities.name: Sabre Cut
abilities.description: Strikes an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Parry Stance
abilities.description: For 2.5 s, gains 50% evade, and each evaded melee blow triggers a counter-strike for 60% Power.

abilities.name: Provoking Flourish
abilities.description: Cuts an adjacent enemy for 90% Power physical damage and taunts it for 1.2 s.

abilities.name: Light Feet
abilities.description: +20% evade. Each evade grants 5% Empowered for 3 s, stacking up to 3 times.

abilities.name: Pike Jab
abilities.description: Jabs an enemy within 1.6 m for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Lock Shields
abilities.description: Gives itself and allies within 4 m a shield worth 10% of its max HP for 4 s.

abilities.name: Pike Thrust
abilities.description: Thrusts 3 m forward: enemies in the line take 120% Power physical damage and are knocked back 2 m.

abilities.name: Formation Drill
abilities.description: Allies within 3 m gain 10 armor. Gains 5 armor per ally within 3 m (up to 15).

abilities.name: Shiv
abilities.description: Stabs an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Shadowstep
abilities.description: Dashes behind an enemy within 8 m and strikes for 160% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.description: Cuts an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage and slows it 40% for 2.5 s.

abilities.name: Unseen Angle
abilities.description: Deals 25% more damage to enemies that are not targeting it.

abilities.name: Rending Axe
abilities.description: Strikes an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Blood Frenzy
abilities.description: For 5 s, gains 50% attack speed and heals for 15% of the damage it deals.

abilities.name: Savage Rend
abilities.description: Rends an adjacent enemy for 80% Power physical damage plus a bleed of 25% Power every 0.5 s for 3 s (stacks twice).

abilities.name: Bloodrush
abilities.description: Deals up to 40% more damage the lower its HP: +0.6% for every 1% of HP missing.

abilities.name: Twin Strike
abilities.description: Strikes an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.description: Channels for 1.2 s, striking its target 6 times for 55% Power physical damage each.

abilities.name: Sidestep
abilities.description: Gains 50% evade and 30% Hasted for 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.description: Each basic hit on the same target grants 6% attack speed for 3 s, stacking 5 times. Switching targets resets it.

abilities.name: Heavy Chop
abilities.description: Chops an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Behead
abilities.description: After a 0.5 s windup, chops for 200% Power physical damage, doubled against enemies below 30% HP. Resets on a kill.

abilities.name: Sunder
abilities.description: Chops for 80% Power physical damage and reduces armor by 25 for 5 s.

abilities.name: Executioner's Eye
abilities.description: +40% critical-hit chance against enemies below 40% HP.

abilities.name: Scythe Sweep
abilities.description: Sweeps an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Whirling Harvest
abilities.description: Channels for 1.5 s while moving at half speed, dealing 35% Power physical damage to enemies within 2 m every 0.25 s.

abilities.name: Reaping Leap
abilities.description: Leaps onto an enemy within 6 m: enemies within 2 m of the landing take 120% Power physical damage and are slowed 30% for 2 s.

abilities.name: Wide Arc
abilities.description: Basic attacks also hit enemies within 1.5 m of the target for 40% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Runed Edge
abilities.description: Strikes an adjacent enemy for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Rune Burst
abilities.description: Bursts runes in a 90° cone within 2.5 m: 140% Power arcane damage and -20 ward for 4 s.

abilities.name: Arc Lunge
abilities.description: Lunges at an enemy within 5 m for 100% Power arcane damage and silences it for 0.8 s.

abilities.name: Third Rune
abilities.description: Every third basic hit deals an extra 80% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Longbow Shot
abilities.description: Shoots an enemy within 8 m for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Aimed Shot
abilities.description: After a 1 s aim, fires for 300% Power physical damage. Stuns and silences interrupt the aim.

abilities.name: Leap Back
abilities.description: Leaps 4 m away from an enemy within 4 m and gains 20% Hasted for 2 s.

abilities.name: Deadeye
abilities.description: Deals 20% more damage to enemies more than 5 m away.

abilities.name: Hand Crossbow
abilities.description: Shoots an enemy within 5.5 m for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Pinning Bolt
abilities.description: Fires a bolt for 120% Power physical damage that roots the target for 1 s.

abilities.name: Tumble Shot
abilities.description: Tumbles 3 m away from an enemy within 3 m, then shoots it for 80% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Light Load
abilities.description: Basic-attack windup is halved and it moves 10% faster.

abilities.name: Ember Bolt
abilities.description: Hurls an ember at an enemy within 6 m for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Firebloom
abilities.description: After 0.6 s, erupts a 2.5 m circle at the target: 120% Power arcane damage and a burn of 15% Power every 0.5 s for 3 s.

abilities.name: Flame Lance
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, hurls a lance 8 m long: enemies in the line take 140% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Kindling
abilities.description: Deals 12% more damage to burning enemies.

abilities.name: Venom Dart
abilities.description: Darts an enemy within 6 m for 80% Power physical damage and a poison stack: 12% Power arcane damage per second for 4 s (up to 3 stacks).

abilities.name: Noxious Flask
abilities.description: After 0.4 s, leaves a 2.2 m cloud for 4 s: enemies inside take 12% Power arcane damage every 0.5 s and receive 40% less healing.

abilities.name: Rupture
abilities.description: Detonates poison on an enemy: 100% Power arcane damage, +60% per poison stack, consuming the stacks.

abilities.name: Festering
abilities.description: Basic hits make the target receive 25% less healing for 4 s.

abilities.name: Spark
abilities.description: Zaps an enemy within 6 m for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.description: After 0.4 s, strikes an enemy for 130% Power arcane damage, then arcs to up to 3 more enemies within 4 m, losing 20% per jump.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Blasts enemies within 2.5 m for 100% Power arcane damage and knocks them back 2.5 m.

abilities.name: Arc Conductor
abilities.description: Every fourth basic hit arcs to up to 2 more enemies within 4 m for 50% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Bounty Bolt
abilities.description: Shoots an enemy within 7 m for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Post the Writ
abilities.description: Marks an enemy within 9 m for 6 s: it takes 15% more damage from all sources.

abilities.name: Weighted Net
abilities.description: Throws a net for 60% Power physical damage that roots the target for 1.2 s.

abilities.name: Collect the Bounty
abilities.description: Deals 20% more damage to marked enemies. When a marked enemy goes down, gains 15% Empowered for 5 s and 25 focus.

abilities.name: Frost Shard
abilities.description: Hurls a shard at an enemy within 6 m for 100% Power arcane damage, slowing it 15% for 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Rime Nova
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, freezes the ground within 3 m: 80% Power arcane damage and roots enemies for 1.2 s.

abilities.name: Glacial Lance
abilities.description: After 0.5 s, fires a lance for 140% Power arcane damage that slows 45% for 3 s.

abilities.name: Deep Chill
abilities.description: Deals 15% more damage to slowed or rooted enemies.

abilities.name: Hex Bolt
abilities.description: Hurls a hex at an enemy within 6.5 m for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Withering Hex
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, weakens an enemy by 25% for 4 s.

abilities.name: Mark of Ruin
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, curses a 2.5 m circle: 50% Power arcane damage and 15% Vulnerable for 4 s.

abilities.name: Lingering Malice
abilities.description: Debuffs it applies last 30% longer.

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.description: Strikes an enemy within 6 m with wind for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Repelling Gale
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, blasts a 90° cone within 4 m: 70% Power arcane damage and 3 m knockback.

abilities.name: Downdraft
abilities.description: After 0.5 s, pulls enemies within 3 m of the target 1.5 m toward it and slows them 30% for 2 s.

abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.description: Allies within 4 m move 10% faster.

abilities.name: Muting Needle
abilities.description: Flicks a needle at an enemy within 6.5 m for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Hush
abilities.description: Instantly silences an enemy within 7 m for 1.5 s, interrupting its cast.

abilities.name: Unravel
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, strips up to 2 buffs (shields included) from an enemy and deals 80% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Quiet Mind
abilities.description: Deals 25% more damage to enemies that are casting or silenced. +15% tenacity.

abilities.name: Lull Mote
abilities.description: Drifts a mote at an enemy within 6 m for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Slumber
abilities.description: After 0.6 s, puts an enemy to sleep for 2.5 s. A hit of 8% of its max HP in one tick wakes it.

abilities.name: Daze Pulse
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, pulses a 2.5 m circle: 60% Power arcane damage and a 0.6 s stun.

abilities.name: Drowsy Air
abilities.description: Crowd control it applies lasts 15% longer.

abilities.name: Barbed Dart
abilities.description: Throws a dart at an enemy within 5.5 m for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Bear Trap
abilities.description: After 0.5 s, sets a trap at an enemy's feet (arms in 0.3 s, lasts 12 s, 2 at most): the first enemy to touch it takes 100% Power physical damage and is rooted 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Tar Pit
abilities.description: After 0.4 s, spills tar in a 2.5 m circle for 5 s: enemies inside are slowed 40%.

abilities.name: Pinned Prey
abilities.description: Enemies it roots are 10% Vulnerable for 2.5 s.

abilities.name: Scalpel Toss
abilities.description: Throws a scalpel at an enemy within 5 m for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Suture
abilities.description: After 0.5 s, heals an ally for 220% Support, 30% more if it is below 35% HP.

abilities.name: Purging Tincture
abilities.description: After 0.2 s, removes all harmful effects from an ally, then heals it 15% Support every 0.5 s for 3 s.

abilities.name: Field Dressing
abilities.description: Every third heal it casts also gives the target 15% Fortified for 3 s.

abilities.name: Chime
abilities.description: Rings a chime at an enemy within 5 m for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Chorus of Mending
abilities.description: After 0.6 s, heals itself and allies within 4.5 m for 100% Support.

abilities.name: Sanctuary Hymn
abilities.description: After 0.4 s, consecrates a 3 m circle at an ally for 5 s: allies inside heal 30% Support each second and are 10% Fortified.

abilities.name: Resonant Voice
abilities.description: It and allies within 4.5 m regenerate 5% of its Support as HP per second.

abilities.name: Sigil Spark
abilities.description: Flings a sigil at an enemy within 6 m for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Inscribe Barrier
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, shields an ally for 200% Support for 5 s.

abilities.name: Ward Lattice
abilities.description: After 0.5 s, shields all allies within 4 m of the target ally for 90% Support for 4 s.

abilities.name: Reinforced Script
abilities.description: When one of its shields breaks, that ally gains 15% Fortified for 2 s.

abilities.name: Thorn Seed
abilities.description: Flicks a seed at an enemy within 5 m for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Rejuvenate
abilities.description: After 0.2 s, heals an ally for 15% Support every 0.5 s for 5 s.

abilities.name: Bloomburst
abilities.description: After 0.5 s, heals allies within 4 m of the target ally for 80% Support.

abilities.name: Deep Roots
abilities.description: Its healing is 30% stronger on allies below 50% HP.

abilities.name: Lantern Flicker
abilities.description: Flicks lantern-fire at an enemy within 5.5 m for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Vigil
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, wards an ally for 4 s: the first blow that would down it leaves it at 1 HP and heals it for 100% Support.

abilities.name: Mend
abilities.description: After 0.6 s, heals an ally for 180% Support.

abilities.name: Lamplight
abilities.description: The first time each ally within 6 m drops below 30% HP in a round, it is healed for 80% Support.

abilities.name: Drumbeat Strike
abilities.description: Sends a booming beat at an enemy within 4 m for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Quickstep Cadence
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, it and allies within 5 m gain 25% attack speed and 15% move speed for 4 s.

abilities.name: Rally Beat
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, heals it and allies within 4.5 m for 70% Support and removes slows and roots.

abilities.name: Marching Rhythm
abilities.description: It and allies within 4 m move 6% faster and regenerate focus 10% faster.

abilities.name: Maul
abilities.description: Strikes an adjacent enemy for 80% Power + 1.2% of its own max HP as physical damage.

abilities.name: Battering Charge
abilities.description: Charges an enemy within 7 m: 60% Power + 6% of its own max HP physical damage and 1.5 m knockback.

abilities.name: Iron Hide
abilities.description: Gains 25% Fortified and 20 armor for 4 s.

abilities.name: Unbowed
abilities.description: Below 50% HP, gains 20 armor and deals 15% more damage.

abilities.name: Arbalest Bolt
abilities.description: Shoots an enemy within 6 m for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Plant the Pavise
abilities.description: Anchors itself for 4 s: cannot move or be displaced, gains 40 armor, 30 ward and 30% attack speed.

abilities.name: Shield Shove
abilities.description: Shoves an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage and 3 m knockback.

abilities.name: Cover
abilities.description: It and allies within 2.5 m take 10% less damage from enemies more than 4 m away.

abilities.name: Chain Flail
abilities.description: Lashes an enemy within 1.5 m for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Shackle
abilities.description: Shackles an enemy within 1.5 m: 80% Power physical damage and rooted for 1.2 s.

abilities.name: Quake Stomp
abilities.description: After 0.4 s, stomps: enemies within 3 m take 60% Power physical damage, are stunned 0.6 s and slowed 30% for 2 s.

abilities.name: Jailer's Reach
abilities.description: Enemies within 2.5 m are slowed 15%.

abilities.name: Boarding Axe
abilities.description: Strikes an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Harpoon
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, harpoons an enemy within 7 m: 80% Power physical damage, pulls it to the Harpooner and taunts it for 1 s.

abilities.name: Anchor Slam
abilities.description: Slams an adjacent enemy for 120% Power physical damage and slows it 40% for 2 s.

abilities.name: Sea Legs
abilities.description: Immune to knockback and pull. +15% tenacity.

abilities.name: Oathblade
abilities.description: Strikes an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Laying of Hands
abilities.description: After 0.4 s, heals an ally within 5 m for 180% Support and gives it 10% Fortified for 3 s.

abilities.name: Consecrate
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, consecrates a 3 m circle around itself for 4 s: each second allies inside heal 25% Support and enemies take 30% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Shared Suffering
abilities.description: 12% of the damage it takes heals the lowest-HP ally within 6 m (not itself).

abilities.name: Bough Swing
abilities.description: Swings at an enemy within 1.3 m for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Take Root
abilities.description: Anchors itself for 5 s with 20% Fortified; each second, it and allies within 4 m heal 25% Support.

abilities.name: Thornlash
abilities.description: Lashes enemies within 2.5 m for 90% Power physical damage and slows them 30% for 2 s.

abilities.name: Sapflow
abilities.description: Regenerates 0.8% of max HP per second; allies within 3 m regenerate 3% of its Support per second.

abilities.name: Trident Thrust
abilities.description: Thrusts at an enemy within 1.6 m for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Cast Net
abilities.description: After 0.2 s, nets an enemy within 4 m: rooted for 1.5 s and slowed 30% for 3.5 s.

abilities.name: Pinning Lunge
abilities.description: Lunges at an enemy within 2.5 m for 130% Power physical damage, 50% more against rooted enemies.

abilities.name: Tangle
abilities.description: Basic hits slow the target 20% for 1.5 s.

abilities.name: Sling Stone
abilities.description: Slings a stone at an enemy within 6 m for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Skullcracker
abilities.description: After 0.4 s, slings a stone for 140% Power physical damage that stuns for 1 s.

abilities.name: Scatter Shot
abilities.description: After 0.2 s, sprays a 60° cone within 6 m: 90% Power physical damage and 30% slow for 2 s.

abilities.name: Concussive
abilities.description: Every fourth basic hit weakens the target by 15% for 3 s.

abilities.name: Leeching Cut
abilities.description: Cuts an adjacent enemy for 100% Power physical damage.

abilities.name: Siphon Strike
abilities.description: Strikes for 150% Power physical damage and heals the lowest-HP ally within 6 m (itself included) for all the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Crimson Mist
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, releases a 3 m mist: enemies take 80% Power physical damage and allies (itself included) heal 60% Support.

abilities.name: Blood Tithe
abilities.description: 15% of all damage it deals heals the lowest-HP ally within 6 m (itself included).

abilities.name: Sunlance
abilities.description: Lances an enemy within 6 m for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Searing Brand
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, burns an enemy for 130% Power arcane damage and Illuminates it for 5 s: allies who damage it heal for 10% of that damage.

abilities.name: Dawn's Mercy
abilities.description: After 0.5 s, heals an ally for 160% Support.

abilities.name: Radiant Zeal
abilities.description: Deals 15% more damage to Illuminated enemies.

abilities.name: Brine Bolt
abilities.description: Hurls brine at an enemy within 6 m for 100% Power arcane damage, slowing it 10% for 1 s.

abilities.name: Undertow
abilities.description: After 0.5 s, floods a 2.8 m circle for 4 s: enemies inside are slowed 40% and allies inside heal 10% Support every 0.5 s.

abilities.name: Cleansing Tide
abilities.description: After 0.3 s, washes allies within 4 m of the target ally: removes 1 harmful effect from each and heals them 70% Support.

abilities.name: Ebb and Flow
abilities.description: When it slows, roots or stuns an enemy, the lowest-HP ally within 6 m heals 20% Support (at most once per 2 s).

abilities.name: Sand Mote
abilities.description: Flings sand at an enemy within 6 m for 100% Power arcane damage.

abilities.name: Rewind Wounds
abilities.description: After 0.4 s, heals an ally for 70% of the damage it took in the last 4 s (at least 80% Support).

abilities.name: Torpor Field
abilities.description: After 0.4 s, mires enemies within 2.5 m of the target: slowed 35% and Sluggish 25% for 3 s.

abilities.name: Hastened Hours
abilities.description: It and allies within 4 m recover ability cooldowns 10% faster.
